title: Braided cochain clopen restriction with prescribed tensor and unit
statement: Let j:Y→X be an open immersion and R a commutative ring sheaf as in [def-pur-clopen-monoidal-normalization]. Give ordinary restriction a strong braided structure h. Let b be the comparison of total tensors with degreewise restriction in [lem-pur-clopen-total-tensor-kflat-detection], satisfying the stated tensor equation on every total-degree summand. Suppose ordinary restriction preserves all coefficient-sized coproducts. Then degreewise restriction has a strong braided structure c whose inverse tensorator is b on every pair of complexes and whose inverse unit is the degree-zero single-complex comparison followed by the single of the inverse ordinary unit. No derived localization or K-flat model normalization is asserted.

proof.text: Transport the assumed coefficient-sized coproduct preservation to each integer total-degree index type using Discrete.equivalence Equiv.ulift. Give ordinary restriction its specified braided structure.

Apply braided_cochain_normalization to ordinary restriction. The supplied hsum is exactly its summand hypothesis for the morphism b.hom.app(P,Q), hence its inverse tensorator equals b. The generic single-complex unit formula is precisely the stated ordinary-unit comparison.

theorem clopen_braided_cochain_normalization
    {X Y : Scheme.{t}} (j : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (R : Sheaf (topology X) CommRingCat.{max u (t + 1)})
    (h : (clopenTensorRestriction.{t, u} j R).Braided)
    (b : coefficientTotalTensor.{u, t + 1, t} (topology X) R ⋙
        clopenTensorComplexRestriction.{t, u} j R ≅
      ((clopenTensorComplexRestriction.{t, u} j R).prod
        (clopenTensorComplexRestriction.{t, u} j R)) ⋙
          coefficientTotalTensor.{u, t + 1, t} (topology Y)
            ((clopenTensorRings.{t, u} j).obj R))
    (hsum : ∀ (P Q : CochainComplex (clopenTensorModules.{t, u} R) ℤ)
      (p q n : ℤ) (hpq : p + q = n),
      (clopenTensorRestriction.{t, u} j R).map
          (clopenTotalTensorSummand.{t, u} R P Q p q n hpq) ≫
          (b.hom.app (P, Q)).f n =
        (clopenTensorComparison.{t, u} j R h (P.X p) (Q.X q)).hom ≫
          clopenTotalTensorSummand.{t, u} ((clopenTensorRings.{t, u} j).obj R)
            ((clopenTensorComplexRestriction.{t, u} j R).obj P)
            ((clopenTensorComplexRestriction.{t, u} j R).obj Q) p q n hpq)
    (hcolim : ∀ (K : Type (max u (t + 1))),
      PreservesColimitsOfShape (Discrete K) (clopenTensorRestriction.{t, u} j R)) :
    ∃ c : (clopenTensorComplexRestriction.{t, u} j R).Braided,
      (∀ P Q : CochainComplex (clopenTensorModules.{t, u} R) ℤ,
        c.toMonoidal.toOplaxMonoidal.δ P Q = b.hom.app (P, Q)) ∧
      c.toMonoidal.toOplaxMonoidal.η =
        ((HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex
          (clopenTensorRestriction.{t, u} j R) (.up ℤ) (0 : ℤ)).app
            (𝟙_ (clopenTensorModules.{t, u} R))).hom ≫
          (HomologicalComplex.single _ (.up ℤ) (0 : ℤ)).map
            (clopenTensorUnitComparison.{t, u} j R h).hom
